statements.status_notes: CVE-2022-24975 ("GitBleed"): the record says the documentation of git clone --mirror in Git through 2.35.1 does not mention that a mirror clone also copies content that is no longer reachable from branches, which could matter if an audit relies on a clone made without --mirror. The CVE record is tagged disputed. Git's maintainer replied on the project list that --mirror is working as intended and that there is nothing more for Git to do: https://public-inbox.org/git/xmqq4k14qe9g.fsf@gitster.g/ . The Debian tracker lists git as unfixed with urgency unimportant: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2022-24975 . No code change is involved, and the --mirror text in Git 2.47.3, which this owner ships, is the same as in the current Git release. Pending a maintainer decision on whether this disputed, documentation-only CVE is recorded as not affected for this owner.
